name: Public Sector Casework, Grants & Higher-Ed Ops
description: Evaluates citizen benefits/aid eligibility with strict missing-document cure holds (never silent denials) and SSN redaction, scores public procurement tenders after mandatory debarment/COI pass-fail gates, and validates research grant budgets (F&A indirect caps, unallowables, PI effort) plus accreditation evidence freshness.

skills.summary: Computes household FPL income eligibility, enforces missing-document cure holds instead of silent denials, and counts PII redactions.
Enforces mandatory debarment/COI/tax pass-fail gates first, then computes lowest-compliant commercial normalization and weighted rank.
Validates MTDC base vs F&A indirect cost caps, flags unallowable expenses, checks PI 100% effort cap, and checks accreditation freshness.

byo_mcp: Grants Management & Procurement Portal MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Query citizen benefit case packets, sealed vendor tender matrices, and sponsored research budgets/PI effort logs from ServiceNow, BigQuery, Drive, or Grants/Procurement MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python compliance validation.

gateway_approval_actions: Issuing statutory citizen benefit eligibility determinations or cure notices via ServiceNow/Case MCP
Recording procurement tender award selections via customer Procurement Portal MCP
Submitting federal/sponsor grant budget certifications via customer Grants Management MCP
python_code_guardrails: Debarred/ineligible vendor hard disqualification blocking award when zero compliant bids exist
MTDC indirect-cost exemption exclusion (equipment/subawards >$25k), unallowable cost blocker, and PI >100% effort cap
Deterministic PENDING_CURE_NOTICE handling preventing silent denial of incomplete citizen packets

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-accreditation-evidence-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly Grant & Accreditation Evidence Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly sponsored grant allowability and accreditation artifact freshness check via scripts/grant_accreditation_validator.py across active institutional packets.
